name: Amita Schmidt
reason: Health and therapy rule: although she is a long-time vipassana teacher (former IMS resident teacher, Dipa Ma book), her current work on her own site (amitaschmidt.com) is one-to-one sessions by telemedicine as a licensed clinical social worker and psychotherapist, she describes leading 'healing depression' workshops, one talks menu is 'Depression, Anxiety, and Trauma', and her YouTube titles as a whole are framed on trauma, difficult emotions and the pandemic; no retreats or events since 2022. A human may revisit if she resumes retreat teaching.
